items.note: Resolved on the current bytes. The recap gives complete, numbered real-machine paths on all three systems. macOS: Temurin .pkg, Maven archive and PATH, then the checks. Windows: .msi or winget with PATH and JAVA_HOME, Maven zip and Path, then the checks. Linux step 1 now says to open a terminal and gives the full Adoptium apt and RPM repository commands for temurin-25-jdk, the sudo and y-prompt expectations, and a done signal. Linux step 2 covers the Maven archive and PATH, and step 3 the checks, with an update-alternatives fix if an older JDK wins. All three paths end with java -version, javac -version and mvn -v with expected output, then the IntelliJ project SDK check. A learner without the toolchain can install it and verify it before the lab.
